tagline: HIMEHINA brings their LIFETIME is BUBBLIN world tour to San Jose Civic, hololive Dreams is four days old, and Koshien coaches are rage-training through the final stretch.

lead.title: HIMEHINA brought their LIFETIME is BUBBLIN world tour to San Jose Civic — the first VTuber duo to headline a US stop on an eight-city world tour
lead.body: OffKai Expo Gen 5 wrapped Sunday after three days at the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, and the weekend's centrepiece came Friday at the San Jose Civic: Tanaka Hime and Suzuki Hina performing the North America leg of HIMEHINA WORLD Tour 2026 LIFETIME is BUBBLIN. Before San Jose, the tour had already run through Fukuoka, Osaka, Sendai, Nagoya, Sapporo, Taipei, and Seoul. HIMEHINA's breakout track Aipai Dancehall has cleared 48 million views; their February solo album Futari Tsumugi Uta — songs written by Hime and Hina themselves — anchored the heavier set pieces. The duo runs their own label, HIMEHINA Inc., making this one of the most ambitious self-managed VTuber touring operations in the scene's history. OffKai Expo also expanded this year into an 80,000-square-foot South Hall with over 780 creator meet-and-greet slots across the weekend. Five years of OffKai, and this is what the ceiling looks like now.

stories.title: hololive Dreams is live — 1.5 million pre-registered players, 150 songs, and the rhythm RPG theme park is open for business
stories.blurb: Four days in: hololive Dreams (COVER Corp and QualiArts) launched July 23 on iOS, Android, and Steam globally. Pre-registration cleared 1.3 million; Cover pushed to 1.5 million ahead of launch, triggering bonus rewards including 2,500 Diamonds and a guaranteed gacha ticket. The game opens with 150-plus songs, 50-plus talent cards, and a theme park structure where rhythm gameplay unlocks new park sections. Cover's first rhythm RPG took years to develop. The week-one signal on whether that wait paid off should start showing in a few days.

stories.title: hololive night Taiwan wrapped after two nights at Taipei Dome — Kumarine's Taipei debut, split admission gifts, two sold-out evenings
stories.blurb: The second night of hololive night Taiwan landed July 22, closing out Cover's annual baseball-crossover run in Taipei. Night One brought Postcard Sets; Night Two switched to Cable Winders. Marine, Kiara, Baelz, Koyori, and Vivi provided recorded content across both evenings, and Houshou Kumarine made her first-ever Taipei appearance in person. This year's run hit Tianmu Baseball Stadium July 4-5 before moving to Taipei Dome for July 21-22 — four nights across two venues. The baseball-x-VTuber format is doing exactly what Cover wanted it to do.

stories.title: Koshien 2026 training enters its final week — ten coaches, critical build decisions, tournament on August 8
stories.blurb: The Nijisanji Koshien 2026 training period (July 5 through August 2) hits its last week starting today, with ten coaches — Rito Usami, Kyoran Meroko, Koyanagi Ro, Ness Sakaki, Suzuna Nanase, Furen E. Lustario, Minato Fuwa, Sara Hoshikawa, Himawari Honma, and Iroas Lauren — finalizing their Power Pros builds before the 3D main tournament kicks off August 8. This is where roster decisions get locked in and the pre-tournament arguments begin in earnest. Koshien season is always good TV. The training arc is half the entertainment.

stories.title: BY THE BEAT 'MERORI' drops Thursday — NijiEN's male unit makes its second release, Japanese version follows August 5
stories.blurb: Four days out: NIJISANJI EN male unit BY THE BEAT releases their second single 'MERORI' this Thursday, with the Japanese version 'MERORI (For Me)' arriving August 5. Production credits include MUTEKI DEAD SNAKE (Snow Man, M!LK). Teaser clips have been running on TikTok and Instagram Reels since the announcement. The unit has publicly targeted a major label debut in 2027 — this is the second step on that runway, and the countdown is almost done.

stories.title: Phase Connect confirmed for San Japan 2026 — Lia, Pippa, Tenma, Uruka, and Lumi in San Antonio this September
stories.blurb: Phase Connect's five-talent San Japan 2026 lineup is locked: Lia, Pippa, Tenma, Uruka, and Lumi at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center in San Antonio, September 4-6. Hotel reservation deadline passed July 25, which means the booking window is closed and the panel schedule is being finalized. No extra ticket needed beyond a general San Japan pass. The Phase Connect convention presence keeps growing past their own Phase Con — September in Texas will be its own thing.

indieSubhead: NO AGENCY, NO PROBLEM — NEWS FROM THE SELF-MADE CORNER OF THE SCENE

indies.title: HIMEHINA's world tour is a structural first — self-managed label, eight cities, four countries, and it worked
indies.blurb: Before San Jose, HIMEHINA had played Fukuoka, Osaka, Sendai, Nagoya, Sapporo, Taipei, and Seoul on this tour — filling venues in each city under their own label, HIMEHINA Inc. Their catalogue stretches from Aipai Dancehall (48M+ views) through their fourth album Bubblin to February's Futari Tsumugi Uta, which gave the tour its more introspective moments. Running your own label means owning the back end of a world tour without an agency underneath you. Nobody had done it at this scale before in this scene. Now someone has.

indies.title: OffKai Expo Gen 5 wrapped Sunday with 780-plus creator slots — the indie meet-and-greet format is now the convention model
indies.blurb: Beyond the headliner concert, OffKai Expo Gen 5 gave fans over 780 creator meet-and-greet opportunities across three days — kson, Henya, Avallum, and a full roster spanning agency names and independent talent. The expanded South Hall and the San Jose Civic as a dedicated concert venue made this the biggest OffKai footprint yet. The meet-and-greet format at this scale gives indie creators convention infrastructure that previously only existed for agency acts. OffKai figured out how to run a VTuber convention. The rest of the scene is taking notes.

indies.title: The post-VShojo indie tier is taking shape — Beastiez and Densetsu.EXE show what the diaspora looks like when it goes right
indies.blurb: With VShojo's 2025 closure and PRISM's 2024 shutdown now a year or more in the rearview, the former-corpo indie tier has had time to reorganize. Beastiez and Densetsu.EXE — both emerging from the VShojo diaspora — represent what successful transitions look like: retained audiences, new creative structures, and unit identities that didn't depend on the mothership. The pattern the scene is watching is whether those audiences stay loyal to the talent rather than the brand. So far, the answer is mostly yes.

tea.text: Word on /vt/ is that the Koshien 2026 coach tier lists have already gone through three revisions this week alone, and no two threads agree on which builds are viable going into the final stretch. The community consensus is that Minato Fuwa and Furen E. Lustario are both doing something strange with their rosters — whether that reads as visionary or tilting depends entirely on which thread you started in. Training ends August 2. The arguments will outlast the final scores.

The rumor mill says post-OffKai Expo shipping energy hit specific fever pitch after certain meet-and-greet photos from the weekend dropped Sunday evening. The parties involved appear to be pretending not to have noticed the tags accumulating. Whether this is a ship moment or just OffKai Expo doing what OffKai Expo does — manufacturing emotional proximity in an enclosed space for three days — is the debate currently costing people productive Monday morning time.

Chatter in the Nijisanji EN male audition threads has evolved past character concept generation into full lore bible construction for people who haven't been cast yet. Multiple 200-post threads have completed design sheets, voice actor wishlists, and ship taxonomies for an unannounced lineup. Auditions close August 1. Whatever gets revealed will land in a fandom that has already decided who these people are and has opinions about it.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday morning — 3 August. Koshien training ends Sunday the 2nd, 'MERORI' will have had three days in the world, and hololive Dreams will have cleared its first full week of numbers. We'll see you there.
